title: Tech giants AI spending to exceed USD 1 trillion in 2027, lift US growth: UBS
snippet: Investment by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure is expected to exceed USD 1 trillion in 2027 as demand for computing capacity continues to outstrip supply, supporting US economic growth despite rising financing needs, according to a report by UBS.

title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple wearable pre-orders open November 1: How to order, expected price, colours and features
